info.title: daq-unity
info.description: Unity conventions for daq (dotnet-assembly-query) - finds your repo's Library/ScriptAssemblies so agents/editors can query it with zero config.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Unity conventions for daq (dotnet-assembly-query) - queries your repo's Library/ScriptAssemblies.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: find-symbol
commands.description: Find all symbols matching <name> (or containing it, with --contains).

options.name: --path
options.description: Extra path to include, alongside the Unity-resolved Library/ScriptAssemblies: a directory (scanned non-recursively) or an assembly file/glob (repeatable).

options.name: --kind
options.description: Restrict matches to this member kind: type, method, field, or property.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Restrict matches to this containing namespace.

options.name: --assembly-name
options.description: Restrict matches to this containing assembly name.

options.name: --assets-only
options.description: Restrict matches to assemblies classified as the project's own Assets code (excludes Packages/package-cache code). Runs in-process only; see README. [default: False]

options.name: --contains
options.description: Match symbols whose name contains <name> (case-insensitive substring match) instead of an exact name match. [default: False]

options.name: --no-daemon
options.description: Run in-process only; never try or spawn a background daemon. [default: False]

options.name: --daemon-idle-timeout
options.description: Idle timeout in seconds before an auto-spawned daemon exits.

options.name: --json
options.description: Output machine-readable JSON instead of human-readable text. [default: False]

options.name: --project
options.description: Start the Unity project root search here instead of the current directory.

options.name: --no-plugin-scan
options.description: Don't auto-include precompiled managed plugin DLLs found under Assets/. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show diagnostic warnings that are hidden by default, e.g. native (non-.NET) DLLs skipped under Assets/. [default: False]

options.name: --auto-framework
options.description: If the target type isn't indexed, discover and load the exact reference assemblies Unity's own build system last used to compile this project (read from Library/Bee/artifacts/*.rsp) to resolve it. See README. [default: False]

options.name: --include-framework-results
options.description: Include types only found via --auto-framework in the results, instead of using them solely to resolve the target type (the default omits them to avoid flooding output with e.g. every BCL implementer of IDisposable). [default: False]
